findings.location: HTML, poem stanza beginning “I used to pray for someone”
findings.source_quote: “To love, laugh with, and cherish, / And dissipate all strife.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the final two lines of the stanza with: “Da amare, con cui ridere e da custodire, / e con cui superare ogni contrasto.” This preserves the source’s meaning without attributing the resolving of all discord specifically to that person.
findings.translation_quote: “Da amare, con cui ridere e da custodire, / che dissipasse ogni discordia.”

findings.location: HTML, stanza beginning “Not long after, I found I was happy”
findings.source_quote: “No outer storm my inner Sunshine could pale.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the line with: “Nessuna tempesta esteriore poteva offuscare il sole interiore.”
findings.translation_quote: “nessuna tempesta esteriore poteva offuscare il mio Sole interiore.”

findings.location: HTML, stanza beginning “For I’ve found that true happiness”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the line with: “senza essere smossi dal fuoco né dalla lotta.”
findings.translation_quote: “senza lasciarci smuovere dal fuoco o dalla discordia.”

findings.source_quote: “And the real source of True Life superb.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the final line with: “ed è la vera e meravigliosa fonte della Vita.”
findings.translation_quote: “e la vera fonte della Vita vera e meravigliosa.”
